flags.why: Nam Triều Tiên is a dated name for the country South Korea, rather than a word meaning South Korean.

The sexual use refers to having sex with a virgin, rather than losing one's own virginity, as illustrated by the passive construction in this [usage discussion](https://vntqn.wordpress.com/2007/07/30/bc-tem/).
flags.fix: to have sex with someone who is a virgin

flags.why: The speaker says he wants to have sex with a virgin, while the translation says he wants to lose his own virginity.
flags.fix: That guy is so lucky! I've got to have sex with a virgin this summer too!

flags.why: This sexual expression crudely treats a person's virginity as a seal to remove, so slang alone does not adequately warn the learner.
The common everyday adjective meaning passionate or enthusiastic is missing, as illustrated by this [workplace usage](https://www.beemart.vn/tinh-than-nhiet-huyet-va-mau-lua-trong-van-hoa-beemart).
flags.fix: Add as the first meaning: adj [informal] | passionate; enthusiastic; fired up. Example: Đội mình chơi rất máu lửa. = Our team plays with great passion.

flags.fix: Add: verb | to put forth (flowers or new leaves). Example: Cây đã bắt đầu đơm hoa. = The tree has started to flower.
